name: context-fold
description: Folds finished work out of a Claude Code session: the messages go to files, a short state and one line per part stay, and Claude reads any part back.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key, read only when Use Jev is on. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

useJev.title: Use Jev
useJev.description: Off by default, even with a key set: the summary model finds the finished topics and every old tool result is shortened. On: Jev finds the topics, picks the tool results to shorten and the project rules to re-add.

foldTurns.title: Fold turns as they close
foldTurns.description: Off by default. On: when a turn ends, its tool calls and results are stored as a fold and one short note takes their place; the request and the final answer stay. The messages before the turn are untouched, so their prompt cache is reused. Each fold shows as a compaction in the transcript.

foldTurnMinChars.title: Fold turns from (characters)
foldTurnMinChars.description: With Fold turns on: a turn is folded when its tool calls and results hold at least this many characters.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: With Use Jev on: minimum Jev probability that a tool result is still needed; below it the result is shortened.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

foldAtTokens.title: Flow threshold (tokens)
foldAtTokens.description: Context size, in tokens, past which the plugin folds the older part at the end of a turn, so Claude Code's own compaction, which runs in the middle of a turn, is rarely reached. It folds again only after the context has gained 30,000 tokens. 0 turns it off. Default 150000.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which the plugin compacts at the end of a turn and then submits a resume prompt. 0 (the default) leaves the timing to Claude Code's own threshold (autoCompactWindow), which compacts mid-turn and continues without a prompt.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

smallContextChars.title: Small context (characters)
smallContextChars.description: At or below this size the shortened tool results stand, however little they cut, and no summary runs.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model that folds the old messages (a short state and one line per part) and, without Jev, finds the finished topics: haiku, sonnet or a full id. Empty: the built-in compact writes the state.

summarizeShare.title: Summarized share
summarizeShare.description: Share of the text that counts as the older part: its tool results are shortened without Jev, and it is folded when no topic is finished. The newest part stays as it is.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a shortened tool result kept in the context; 0 keeps only the note. The full text stays readable through the unfold tool.

pruneTopics.title: Fold finished topics
pruneTopics.description: Asks the summary model (or Jev, with Use Jev on) which old turns belong to a finished topic, and folds them.

topicThreshold.title: Topic threshold
topicThreshold.description: Minimum probability that the current topic started after a turn for that turn to go.

lastingThreshold.title: Lasting fact threshold
lastingThreshold.description: A turn whose lasting-fact score reaches this value stays.

resumeAfterCompact.title: Resume after compaction
resumeAfterCompact.description: After an automatic compaction, submit a prompt so the model continues the task without waiting for the user.

rulesFiles.title: Rule files
rulesFiles.description: Comma-separated files the project rules live in, relative to the project root (CLAUDE.md, docs/decisions/*.md). After a summary the plugin adds an index of their sections and, in full, the introductions and, with Use Jev on, the 1-2 sections Jev picks for the work in progress. Empty: off.

decisionLog.title: Decision log
decisionLog.description: Off by default. On: write one JSON record per compaction (trigger, outcome, scores, summary model, time, fold ids) and one per unfold call (id or query, hits), one per turn fold, and after each compaction the prompt-cache tokens of the next request, under the log directory. The records hold request texts and tool inputs from your sessions.

logDir.title: Decision log directory
logDir.description: Where the decision log is written. Leave unset for ~/.claude/context-fold/logs.
